current_locking: namespace allocation and retirement share evaluation/v4_runs/.namespace-allocation.lock; parent writes its ledger after releasing lifecycle lock
current_crash_recovery: partial artifacts are preserved and automatic resume forbidden; no unified transaction reconciliation state machine
why_fail_closed: A detached transaction journal does not protect direct adapter/parent entry points; r6 authorization and validators do not recognize its state. Wiring requires coordinated r7 freeze and a fresh compatible authorization, neither can be inferred or fabricated here.
power_loss_durability_claim: NO; fsync calls are present in the prototype, but storage-device/controller cache guarantees were not established
